title: Looking for traders for a two-weeks AI Trading Challenge ($2,500 prize)
author: Fynca
selftext:
After speaking with more then 50 analysts worldwide, we built Fynca, an AI-powered visual workspace for reseaching market ideas.  
Now we're inviting traders to test it in a simulated trading challenge. each traders gets demo capital cash, after 11 days, the trader with the highest returen wins real cash prize, up to 2,500$.  
No real money traded, Just your research, strategy, and execution.
